title: Ingo Swann remote views alien base on the Moon
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Ingo Swann remote views alien base on the Moon, about 1970s at the Moon (remote viewing), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Ingo Swan uh claimed to have used remote viewing to travel to the moon where he believed there were aliens who forced him off the the moon.
